name: harness-mods
description: Claude Code mods deployed by the harness

plugins.name: nudge-band
plugins.description: Scope, wiki and repo hygiene state in a band above the prompt, with edge-triggered reminders for Claude

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Warns before a cold prompt cache re-bills the whole context, and shows the cache and subagent state on the status line

plugins.name: guard-watch
plugins.description: Counts settings-hook guard blocks on the status line, and toasts the ones that hit a subagent
